selected_estimator.selection_reason: Lowest predeclared mean p90 and median angular errors on the development cases; runtime remained below two seconds for all eight development evaluations at this length.

rotation_covariance.comparison: Nearest interface point after inverse rigid rotation; no binary-mask equality requirement.

required_resolution_trend: At the finest grid, p90 angular error may not exceed the coarsest value by more than 0.5 degree, and surface-area error must be lower than at the coarsest grid.

resolution_gate.policy: One- and two-voxel seeds are reported only as unresolved diagnostics and cannot count as facet-convergence evidence.

go_no_go: GO requires every locked geometry, analytical invariant, and finest-grid rotation-covariance check to pass without post-lock threshold or parameter changes.
